articles.headline: Hometown hero Gunner Stockton back in spotlight for Georgia
articles.description: The Bulldogs QB is a quiet leader, but those who have known him over the years eagerly sing his praises.

images.caption: A man of few words, Gunner Stockton gets people's attention when he has something to say.

article.story: CHARLOTTE, N.C. -- — Marcus Stokes threw for a career-high five touchdowns and Memphis routed Charlotte 59-8 on Saturday in an American Conference opener. Stokes completed 20 of 25 passes for 318 yards. Jermane Hayes caught six passes for 163 yards and a touchdown. Memphis (4-1) moved its record to 7-7 in conference openers since joining the American in 2013. Before halftime, Stokes threw scoring passes of 93, 25 and 28 to Hayes, Jemyri Davis and Hunter Tipton, respectively. Philippe Laforge closed the first half with a 20-yard field for a 24-0 lead. Charlotte (0-5) got on the board when Henry Rutledge ran 75 yards untouched down the right sideline on the first play from scrimmage to start the third quarter. The two-point conversion reduced the deficit to 24-8. Memphis countered with a six-play, 75-yard drive that ended with Stokes throwing a 19-yard touchdown pass to Stonka Burnside. Rutledge ran six times for 111 yards. It was the Tigers' largest win since they beat North Alabama 59-0 on Nov. 19, 2022. The game start was moved to 11 a.m. EST from the previous scheduled start of 3:30 p.m. EST in anticipation of inclement weather later in the day. Up next Memphis: Travels to face UAB next Saturday. Charlotte: Will try again for its first when the 49ers travel to face North Texas next Saturday. ------ Sign up for Top 25 poll alerts here.
